title: 第130章侠义照肝胆第129章漂泊觅归途
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：长安剑客萧书生叁西凉孤剑第130章侠义照肝胆（..la）潼关秋深，风卷黄沙漫过层层黄土塬。
此地南枕秦岭余脉，北临黄河绝壑，东西塬壑交错、沟壑纵横，十里坡连绵起伏，坡地高低错落，荒草漫覆断岩残土，是关中东路最险的咽喉要道。自古兵家在此布防，三里一戍、五里一墩，旧日的烽火台残垣隐于荒草之间，断壁上犹存斑驳刀痕，岁岁被风沙打磨，藏尽百年杀伐旧事。黄巷坂古道蜿蜒穿行于塬沟之间，路窄处仅容单人独行，一侧是陡峭土崖，一侧是万丈深沟，地势险峻至极，历来是行旅畏途、江湖纷争之地。
时近黄昏，残阳如血，泼洒在十里坡的荒径上，将漫天飞沙染成赤红。风过荒坡，草叶呜咽，夹杂着远处黄河奔涌的涛声，天地间尽是苍凉肃杀之气。
萧琰立在半坡断崖之上，一身青布劲装洗得发白，边角磨出细碎毛边，腰间悬着一柄三尺青锋，剑鞘古朴无华，只在吞口处刻着一道极简的云纹。他身形挺拔如松，脊背笔直，肩头落着薄薄一层黄沙，却丝毫不显狼狈。秋风猎猎吹动他束发的青绳，几缕碎发垂在额前，遮住了眼底沉敛的锋芒。他目光远眺，望向潼关关城方向，暮色中那座雄关轮廓巍峨，锁死关中门户，山河天险，壁垒森严。
萧琰并非江湖扬名的侠客，无名门师承，无显赫名头，半生行走江湖，唯守一身孤直侠气。年少时逢乱世流离，见惯豪强欺凌弱小、贪官鱼肉百姓，便立誓以剑立身、以义行事。数年辗转南北，凭手中青锋惩恶扬善，不结狐朋、不慕名利，孤身一人踏遍山河，见过市井烟火，也历过刀光血雨。此番西入潼关，本是听闻陕州一带盗匪横行，劫掠行旅、残害乡民，特意绕道前来，欲扫清这十里坡的祸患，还往来路人一片安稳。
他脚下荒草倒伏，指尖轻轻摩挲着剑柄，微凉的木质触感稳住了心头波澜。一路西行，他见尽流离疾苦，官道之上随处可见弃置的行囊、破损的车马，偶有散落的布衣碎片，皆是过往遭劫行旅的痕迹。十里坡地势复杂、沟壑藏险，最易藏污纳垢，一众盗匪盘踞于此，仗着天险肆无忌惮，劫掠往来商客、山野乡民，官府屡次派兵清剿，皆因地势险峻、盗匪飘忽不定，屡屡无功而返，久而久之，此处便成了无人敢管的法外之地。
风声忽的一滞，原本呜咽的草声骤然沉寂。
萧琰眼眸微凝，周身气息瞬间收敛，整个人如静立的山石，不动声色。他行走江湖多年，早已练就敏锐感知，周遭细微异动皆逃不过他的察觉。这般骤然死寂，绝非自然天象，必是有人刻意敛息隐匿，蛰伏暗处。
下一瞬，东侧荒谷之中，骤然响起兵刃破空之声！
叮叮当当的金铁交鸣穿透秋风，夹杂着怒喝与闷哼，此起彼伏。荒谷地势低洼，声音回荡其间，层层叠叠传开，透着凌厉凶险之意。萧琰身形一动，足尖轻点黄土，身形如青燕掠风，顺着坡势疾驰而下。他脚步轻盈，踏过倒伏的荒草、凸起的岩块，身形起落间不带半分烟火气，转瞬便奔至谷口隐蔽处，藏身于巨大的土崖之后，悄然观望。
谷中局势，尽收眼底。
只见十余名山贼装束的汉子手持钢刀，团团围困着一人。山贼个个面色凶悍、衣衫粗陋，腰间别着短刃，脸上带着悍戾之色，显然是常年劫掠的亡命之徒。被围之人一身玄色短打，身形魁梧挺拔，肩宽背厚，手持一柄厚重阔背刀，刀身寒光凛冽，每一次劈砍都带着千钧之力，劲风呼啸，逼得周遭山贼连连后退。
此人正是孙栋。
孙栋刀法刚猛霸道，大开大合，招式间尽是堂堂正正的杀伐之气，毫无花哨伎俩，招招狠辣、式式致命。他早年曾从军戍边，镇守边关数年，历经沙场血战，刀法皆是战场搏杀的实战功夫，远比寻常江湖武人凌厉狠绝。后来看透官场昏暗、兵将倾轧，不愿同流合污，毅然辞官归乡，辗转江湖，专好打抱不平、劫富济贫。此番途经十里坡，撞见一众山贼劫掠一队逃难乡民，当即出手相救，却不料山贼人数众多、悍不畏死，缠斗许久，始终无法脱身。
此刻孙栋肩头衣衫已然撕裂，一道狭长刀伤横贯肩头，暗红血迹浸透黑衣，顺着手臂缓缓滴落，落在黄土之上，晕开点点暗沉血痕。激战良久，他气息已然不稳，胸口微微起伏，额间布满细密汗珠，却依旧眼神锐利如鹰，毫无半分退怯之意。阔背刀横扫劈斩，劲风凌厉，逼退近身的数名山贼，嗓音沉如惊雷，冷喝出声：“尔等鼠辈，盘踞天险、残害百姓，今日便是你们的死期！”
为首的山贼头目满脸横肉，手持一柄鬼头刀，刀刃斑驳，带着层层血痕，闻言嗤笑一声，语气阴狠暴戾：“老子们在十里坡立足三年，官府都奈何不得，你一个孤身过客，也敢在此充好汉？兄弟们，加把劲！砍翻这莽夫，今日便拿他的头颅祭旗！”
话音落下，剩余山贼气势暴涨，纷纷嘶吼着挥刀扑上。刀锋交错、寒光闪烁，密密麻麻的刀网层层包裹，封死了孙栋所有进退之路。孙栋咬牙凝神，阔背刀轮转如风，硬生生格挡招架，金铁撞击的脆响连绵不绝，震得人耳膜嗡嗡作响。奈何山贼人数悬殊，且个个凶悍拼命，缠斗许久，他体力消耗巨大，招式渐渐滞涩，肩头旧伤牵扯，每动一下都牵扯剧痛，冷汗浸透衣衫，局势愈发凶险。
崖后的萧琰静静观望片刻，心中已然了然。
孙栋刀法雄浑刚毅，根基扎实、心性坚韧，身陷重围而不退半步，宁死不折风骨，绝非伪善逞凶之辈。反观一众山贼，招式阴狠刁钻，专挑要害下手，出手皆是伤人夺命的歹毒路数，常年作恶多端，罪无可赦。
江湖行路，最难得便是赤子侠心、肝胆相照。萧琰本就为清剿盗匪而来，此刻见义士身陷绝境，自然不会袖手旁观。

无需迟疑，萧琰手腕轻振，腰间青锋应声出鞘。
铮——
一声清越剑鸣划破荒谷，清亮悠远，压过漫天金铁交鸣之声。剑光如雪，瞬间刺破沉沉暮色，一道青影自崖后凌空跃出，身形轻盈飘逸，宛若流云坠地，无声无息落入场中。
山贼众人骤然闻声转头，皆是一惊。只见那青衣少年身姿清雅，眉目沉静，周身无半分凶悍戾气，却自带一股凛然正气，手中长剑寒芒吞吐，剑气内敛却暗藏锋芒，明明孤身一人，却压得全场悍匪气息一滞。
“哪里来的毛头小子，敢管老子的闲事？”山贼头目瞳孔一缩，厉声呵斥，手中鬼头刀一横，警惕地盯着萧琰，“识相的速速退去，不然连你一同斩杀！”
萧琰未曾理会他的威胁，目光淡淡扫过满地凶徒，最后落在负伤喘息的孙栋身上，声线清冽平稳，不带半分波澜：“兄台撑住，余下的，交给我。”
孙栋抬眼望去，望见萧琰沉静笃定的眉眼，那双眼澄澈通透，不见半分怯意，唯有一身坦荡侠气。他征战江湖多年，识人无数，一眼便知眼前少年绝非寻常江湖浪子，身怀真本事、心藏大义。当下不言多谢，只重重点头，沉声道：“有劳兄弟！这帮匪贼凶悍狡诈，千万小心！”
话音未落，两名贴身山贼已然持刀扑向萧琰，刀锋凛冽，直劈面门，招式凶狠刁钻。萧琰身形不闪不避，待刀锋将至身前寸许，身形骤然侧滑，步法灵动飘逸，恰好避开攻势。同时手腕轻抖，青锋长剑划出一道细碎弧光，快如闪电。
两道浅浅血线骤然从两名山贼脖颈浮现，二人动作瞬间僵住，手中钢刀哐当落地，甚至来不及惨叫一声，便直直倒地，没了声息。
一剑制敌，干净利落，毫无拖泥带水。
场中剩余山贼尽数色变，脸上悍戾褪去，涌上惊惧之色。他们常年盘踞十里坡，劫掠无数，见过的江湖武人不在少数，却从未见过这般迅捷凌厉的剑法。出手无声、落剑无痕，招式轻柔却杀机暗藏，举重若轻，远胜寻常刚猛路数。
山贼头目心头一沉，知晓遇上了硬茬，却依旧不肯罢休，厉声嘶吼：“都别慌！他不过一人一剑，咱们人多势众，乱刀砍死他！”
剩余八名山贼闻言，立刻调整阵型，两两配合，分左右两路夹击而上，刀光森森，封锁萧琰周身所有方位，攻势凌厉迅猛，凶悍至极。
萧琰神色依旧淡然，脚下步法变幻，身形游走于刀光之间，如闲庭信步。他的剑法不求刚猛制胜，专以快、巧、稳见长，避实击虚、后发先至，每一剑都精准拿捏敌人招式破绽。长剑轻挑、斜削、点刺，剑光流转间，格挡、反击、破招一气呵成，没有半分多余动作。
铛！铛！铛！
密集的金铁碰撞声接连响起，山贼呼啸的攻势尽数被萧琰从容化解。但凡近身兵刃，皆被他一剑精准磕开，力道拿捏恰到好处，既卸去对方攻势，又震得山贼手腕发麻、兵刃震颤。数息之间，又有三名山贼接连中剑，或伤手腕、或破肩甲，惨叫着退出战圈，再无力缠斗。
另一边，孙栋见有人相助，心头压力骤减，当即凝神调息，稳住身形。他紧握阔背刀，沉腰扎马，剩余的疲惫与伤痛尽数压下，眼中锋芒再盛。原本凝滞的刀法再度凌厉起来，刚猛霸道的招式再度铺开，剩余几名山贼被他雷霆攻势压制，节节败退，阵脚大乱。
一刚一柔，一猛一巧，两人从未配合，却莫名默契至极。
萧琰身法灵动，游走外围，精准斩断山贼合围之势，封堵所有退路，瓦解敌方阵型；孙栋正面强攻，势如破竹，凭借雄浑力道正面碾压，破开贼众防线。青锋剑轻灵诡谲，阔背刀厚重沉稳，两路截然不同的武功路数交织在一起，相辅相成、相得益彰，瞬间扭转全场局势。
暮色渐沉，夜色悄然浸染十里坡。荒谷之中，刀光剑影交错闪烁，风声、兵刃声、喝喊声交织回荡。山贼虽凶悍亡命，却在两人默契配合的攻势下节节溃败，死伤不断，剩余之人人心惶惶，再无半分斗志。

不多时，场中仅剩山贼头目一人。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chang'an Swordsman Xiao Shusheng San Xiliang Gujian Chapter 130 Chivalry Shines on the Liver and Gallbladder (..la) The autumn in Tongguan is deep, and the wind rolls yellow sand over the layers of loess plateaus.
This place rests on the remnants of the Qinling Mountains in the south and faces the Yellow River in the north. The east and west plateaus are intertwined with ravines, and the slopes are undulating for ten miles. The slopes are staggered, and the weeds cover the broken rocks and residual soil. It is the most dangerous choke point on the East Kanto Road. Since ancient times, military strategists have set up defenses here, with one garrison for three miles and one pier for five miles. The ruins of the old beacon tower are hidden among the weeds. There are still mottled knife marks on the broken walls. They have been polished by wind and sand every year, hiding the past killings of hundreds of years. The Huangxiangban Ancient Road meanders between plateaus and ravines. The road is narrow and can only accommodate a single person walking alone. One side is a steep earth cliff, and the other side is a deep ravine. The terrain is extremely dangerous. It has always been a place where travelers are afraid of the journey and where there are disputes between rivers and lakes.
It was nearly dusk, and the setting sun was like blood, splashing on the deserted path ten miles uphill, dyeing the flying sand in the sky red. The wind blows over the barren slopes, and the grass blades moan, mixed with the sound of the roaring waves of the Yellow River in the distance, and the world is filled with desolation and murderous atmosphere.
Xiao Yan stood on the cliff on the half slope, wearing a green cloth outfit that had been washed white with fine burrs on the corners. A three-foot green sword hung on his waist. The scabbard was simple and plain, with only a minimalist cloud pattern carved on the mouth. His figure was as tall as a pine tree, his back straight, and there was a thin layer of yellow sand on his shoulders, but he didn't look embarrassed at all. The autumn wind blew the green rope that bound his hair, and a few strands of broken hair hung in front of his forehead, covering the sharp edge under his eyes. He looked far away, towards the Tongguan Pass. In the dusk, the outline of the majestic pass was majestic, locking the gate in the pass. The mountains, rivers, and sky were dangerous, and the barriers were tight.
Xiao Yan was not a famous chivalrous person in the world. He came from an unknown school and had no prominent name. He spent half of his life traveling around the world, maintaining his aloof and chivalrous spirit. When he was young, he was exiled in troubled times and saw powerful men bullying the weak and corrupt officials preying on the common people, so he swore to stand upright with the sword and act with justice. He traveled north and south for several years, using the green blade in his hand to punish evil and promote good. He made no friends or sought fame and fortune. He traveled all over the mountains and rivers alone, saw fireworks in the market, and experienced swords and blood. This time when I entered Tongguan from the west, I heard that bandits were rampant in the Shaanzhou area, robbing travelers and killing villagers, so I took a special detour in order to clear away the troubles on this ten-mile slope and make passers-by feel safe.
Weeds fell beneath his feet, and his fingertips gently rubbed the hilt of the sword. The cool wooden touch calmed the waves in his heart. Along the way westward, he saw all the hardships of being displaced. Abandoned luggage, broken carriages and horses, and occasionally scattered fragments of cloth could be seen everywhere on the official roads, all traces of past robberies and travels. The terrain of Shilipo is complex and the ravines are dangerous, making it the easiest place to hide dirt and evil. A group of bandits are entrenched here, taking advantage of the natural dangers to plunder merchants and villagers in the mountains and countryside. The government has repeatedly sent troops to clear out the area. However, due to the steep terrain and the erratic nature of the bandits, they often return without success. Over time, this place has become a lawless place that no one dares to control.
The sound of the wind suddenly stopped, and the originally whimpering sound of grass suddenly fell silent.
Xiao Yan's eyes narrowed slightly, and the aura around him instantly converged. His whole body was as calm as a standing stone. He has traveled around the world for many years and has already developed a keen sense of perception. Even the slightest movement around him cannot escape his detection. Such sudden deathly silence is definitely not a natural celestial phenomenon. Someone must have deliberately held back their breath and lurked in the dark.
The next moment, in the deserted valley on the east side, the sound of weapons piercing the air suddenly sounded!
The tinkling sound of gold and iron penetrated the autumn wind, mixed with angry shouts and muffled hums, one after another. The desolate valley is low-lying, and the sound echoes in it, spreading layer by layer, conveying a fierce and dangerous meaning. Xiao Yan moved his body, tapped the loess with his toes, and galloped down the slope like a blue swallow flying in the wind. With light steps, he stepped over the fallen grass and raised rocks. His body rose and fell without any trace of fireworks. In an instant, he rushed to the hidden place at the mouth of the valley, hid behind the huge earth cliff, and watched quietly.
The situation in the valley can be seen at a glance.
I saw more than ten men dressed as bandits holding steel knives, surrounding one person. The bandits all have fierce looks and rough clothes.With a short blade on his waist and a fierce look on his face, he was obviously a desperado who had been plundering all year round. The besieged man was dressed in a short black suit. He was tall and tall, with broad shoulders and a thick back. He was holding a thick broad-backed knife. The blade of the knife was cold and cold. Every slash was carried with great force. The strong wind howled, forcing the surrounding bandits to retreat.
This person is Sun Dong.
Sun Dong's sword skills are fierce and domineering, with wide opening and closing, and his moves are filled with an upright killing spirit. There are no fancy tricks. His moves are ruthless and his styles are deadly. In his early years, he joined the army to guard the border and guarded the border for several years. He experienced bloody battles on the battlefield, and his sword skills were all actual battlefield fighting skills, which were far more powerful and ruthless than ordinary warriors. Later, he saw through the gloomy officialdom and the strife between soldiers and generals, and refused to join in the mischief. He resolutely resigned and returned to his hometown, where he traveled around the world, specializing in fighting injustice, robbing the rich and giving to the poor. Passing through Shilipo this time, I encountered a group of bandits robbing a group of fleeing villagers. I immediately came to rescue them. However, I did not expect that the bandits were numerous and fearless. They fought for a long time and were unable to escape.
At this moment, the clothes on Sun Dong's shoulders were torn, and a narrow knife wound ran across his shoulders. Dark red blood stains soaked into the black clothes, slowly dripping down his arms, falling on the loess, and spreading out a few dark blood stains. After a fierce battle for a long time, his breath was already unstable, his chest was rising and falling slightly, and his forehead was covered with fine beads of sweat, but his eyes were still as sharp as an eagle, showing no signs of retreating. The broad-backed sword swept across and chopped, and the strong wind forced back several bandits who were approaching. His voice was as deep as thunder, and he shouted coldly: "You rats, you are entrenched in the natural dangers and harming the people. Today is the day for your death!"
The leader of the bandit had a fleshy face and was holding a ghost-headed sword with mottled blades and layers of bloodstains. He sneered when he heard this and said in a vicious tone: "I have been based in Shilipo for three years, and the government can do nothing. You, a lonely passerby, dare to act like a hero here? Brothers, work harder! Cut down this reckless man, and I will sacrifice his head to the flag today!"
After the words fell, the remaining bandits' momentum surged, and they all roared and charged at him with their swords. The blades intertwined, the cold light flashed, and the dense knife network wrapped up layer by layer, blocking all Sun Dong's ways of advance and retreat. Sun Dong gritted his teeth and concentrated, the broad-backed sword rotated like the wind, and he blocked and parried. The crisp sound of the collision of gold and iron was continuous, making people's eardrums buzz. However, there was a huge disparity in the number of bandits, and they were all fierce and desperate. After fighting for a long time, his physical strength was exhausted, and his moves gradually became sluggish. An old injury on his shoulder caused severe pain every time he moved. His clothes were soaked in cold sweat, and the situation became more and more dangerous.
Xiao Yan, who was behind the cliff, watched quietly for a moment, already understanding in his heart.
Sun Dong's swordsmanship is powerful and resolute, with a solid foundation and a tenacious mind. He will not retreat even half a step when he is under heavy siege. He would rather die than lose his integrity. He is definitely not a hypocritical and vicious person. On the other hand, the bandits are vicious and cunning in their moves, and they specialize in targeting key points. They use vicious methods to injure and kill people. They have committed many crimes all year round, and their crimes are unforgivable.
When traveling in the world, the most rare thing is to be honest and sincere. Xiao Yan originally came to suppress the bandits, but now that he saw the righteous man in dire straits, he naturally would not stand idly by.
Without any hesitation, Xiao Yan flicked his wrist, and the Qingfeng at his waist was unsheathed.
Zheng——
A clear and distant sound of the sound of a sword cut through the deserted valley, overpowering the sound of gold and iron that filled the sky. The sword's light was like snow, instantly piercing the dark dusk. A green shadow jumped out from behind the cliff, its figure was light and elegant, like a flowing cloud falling to the ground, falling silently into the field.
The bandits suddenly turned their heads when they heard the sound, and they were all shocked. I saw the young man in green with an elegant figure and calm eyes. There was no fierceness in his body, but he had an awe-inspiring righteousness. The long sword in his hand breathed out cold light, and the sword energy was restrained but with a hidden edge. He was obviously alone, but he suppressed the atmosphere of all the gangsters in the room.
"Where do you dare to meddle in my own business?" The bandit leader shrank his pupils and scolded sternly. He raised the ghost-headed knife in his hand and stared at Xiao Yan warily, "If you are wise, retreat quickly, or I will kill you too!"
Xiao Yan ignored his threat and looked at him lightly.He swept across the murderers on the floor, and finally landed on Sun Dong, who was injured and gasping for breath. His voice was clear and steady, without any waves: "Brother, hold on, leave the rest to me."
Sun Dong raised his eyes and saw Xiao Yan's calm and determined features. Those eyes were clear and transparent, showing no trace of timidity, only a magnanimous and chivalrous air. He has been fighting in the world for many years and has met countless people. He can tell at a glance that the young man in front of him is no ordinary prodigal in the world. He has real abilities and a righteous heart. He didn't say any thanks at the moment, he just nodded heavily and said solemnly: "Thank you, brother! These bandits are fierce and cunning, so be careful!"
Before he finished speaking, the two bandits who were close to him had already rushed towards Xiao Yan with knives. The blades were sharp and they struck directly at the door. Their moves were vicious and cunning. Xiao Yan did not dodge or dodge. When the blade was about to reach a few inches in front of him, he suddenly slid sideways. His footwork was agile and elegant, just in time to avoid the attack. At the same time, his wrist shook slightly, and the Qingfeng sword drew a thin arc of light, as fast as lightning.
Two shallow lines of blood suddenly appeared from the necks of the two bandits. Their movements froze instantly. The steel knives in their hands clattered to the ground. They didn't even have time to scream, and they fell straight to the ground without making a sound.
Defeat the enemy with one sword, cleanly and without any sloppiness.
The expressions of all the remaining bandits in the field changed, their vehemence faded away, and a look of fear filled their faces. They have been entrenched on Shili Slope all year round and have looted countless times. They have seen many warriors in the martial arts world, but they have never seen such swift and sharp swordsmanship. The strike is silent and the falling sword leaves no trace. The moves are gentle but with hidden murderous intent. The movements are as light as the weight, which is far more powerful than ordinary moves.
The bandit leader's heart sank. He knew that he was facing a tough fight, but he still refused to give up. He shouted sternly: "Don't panic! He is just one person and one sword. We are outnumbered and will chop him to death!"
Hearing this, the remaining eight bandits immediately adjusted their formation, coordinated in pairs, and attacked from the left and right. The swords were shining brightly, blocking all directions around Xiao Yan. The attack was fierce, fast, and extremely ferocious.
Xiao Yan's expression remained indifferent, his footwork changed, and his figure wandered between the sword lights, as if strolling in a courtyard. His swordsmanship does not seek to win with force, but rather with speed, skill, and stability. He avoids the real and hits the weak, striking at the last and striking first. With every sword strike, he accurately identifies the flaw in the enemy's moves. The long sword is lightly lifted, slashed, and stabbed. As the sword light flows, blocking, counterattacking, and breaking moves are all done in one go, without any extra movement.
clang! clang! clang!
The dense collision of gold and iron sounded one after another, and Xiao Yan calmly defused all the bandit's roaring attacks. All close-range weapons were knocked away by his sword with precision, and the force was just right. It not only dispelled the opponent's attack, but also shocked the bandit's wrists to numbness and the weapons to tremble. Within a few breaths, three more bandits were hit with swords one after another. Some of them injured their wrists or broke their shoulder armor. They screamed and retreated from the battle circle, unable to fight anymore.
On the other side, when Sun Dong saw someone helping him, the pressure in his heart suddenly decreased, and he immediately concentrated on regulating his breathing and stabilizing his body. He grasped the broad-backed sword tightly, lowered his waist and braced his horse, suppressing all the remaining fatigue and pain, and the sharpness in his eyes became stronger again. The originally stagnant sword skills became sharp again, and the fierce and domineering moves were once again spread out. The remaining bandits were suppressed by his thunderous offensive, and they retreated steadily, and their positions were in chaos.
One strong and one soft, one fierce and one clever, the two never cooperated, but they had an inexplicable tacit understanding.
Xiao Yan's movement was agile and he moved to the periphery, accurately cutting off the bandits' encirclement, blocking all retreats, and disintegrating the enemy's formation; Sun Dong's frontal attack was as powerful as breaking bamboo, and he used his powerful force to crush the bandits frontally and break through the bandits' defense line. The Qingfeng sword is light and treacherous, while the broad-backed sword is thick and steady. The two completely different martial arts methods are intertwined, complementing each other and bringing out the best in each other, instantly changing the situation of the whole scene.
The dusk is getting darker, and the night quietly saturates the ten-mile slope. In the deserted valley, the lights of swords and shadows flickered, and the sounds of wind, blades, and shouts intertwined and echoed. Although the bandits were fierce and desperate, they were defeated step by step under the tacit cooperation of the two men. The casualties continued. The remaining people were panicked and had no fighting spirit.
Not long after, only the bandit leader was left in the field.
